entries.03b55a62aafb9b13: These include sales of lots for sale, sublease of office buildings leased and re-leased, sale of office condominium ownership rights, and real estate brokerage. Of revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026, revenue arising from contracts with customers was ¥3,216 million, and there is also other revenue such as rental income.
entries.1a052fb884ebfa60: This business operates and manages mega-solar power generation facilities. Power is generated at the “Tama Home Ariake Mega Solar Power Plant” in Omuta City, Fukuoka Prefecture, and electricity is sold to Kyushu Electric Power Co., Inc. under the feed-in tariff scheme. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥804 million.
entries.2953c7e1cd1d9d8d: This is a business not included in the reportable segments.
entries.469c7870f52ebd13: This business centers on sales of detached houses for sale, and also covers condominium planning, development and sales, sublease of office buildings (leasing and re-leasing), sale of office condominium ownership rights, and real estate brokerage. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥54,917 million.
entries.55f283fe96cae1c7: This business's main operations are purchasing used condominiums and reselling them after renovation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥909 million.
entries.5ba357b5718e60dd: These include ancillary work such as demolition and exterior construction, and introducing partner companies for moving services and internet line contracts. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥1,346 million.
entries.83429f544ae4903b: This business is not included in any reportable segment. It includes advertising agency services (Tama Ad Co., Ltd.), furniture sales and interior construction contracting (Tama Living Co., Ltd.), ground surveys and ground guarantees (Zaiju Business Co., Ltd.), agriculture (Tama Agri Co., Ltd.), vehicle leasing (TH Auto Lease Co., Ltd.), and overseas investment, information gathering and development, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥5,149 million.
entries.969b23f223267db8: A homebuilder whose core business is contracted construction of custom-built houses, and which also handles real estate businesses such as the sale of detached houses and condominiums, insurance agency, solar power generation and more.
entries.9b5a874e7a757cd3: This business performs insurance agency services for fire, earthquake and life insurance, and, through its subsidiary Tama Finance Co., Ltd., handles brokerage of bridge loans for purchasers of custom-built homes. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥965 million.
entries.a1ef8ed562fce2c4: This business performs renovation work, including maintenance and extension or remodeling of houses after handover. Centered on warranty extension work, it also handles housing equipment installation work. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥10,062 million.
entries.a7c45291235a44bf: This business centers on contracting for the construction of custom-built homes. It enters into construction contracts for detached houses with customers and handles design and construction (construction management). It operates 183 roadside independent stores and 51 housing exhibition sites nationwide across 47 prefectures (as of May 31, 2026). The flagship product is the “Daianshin no Ie” series, characterized by free design, all-electric systems and a wide range of equipment specifications. It also provides design support operations, such as precut CAD data entry and drawing preparation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥135,902 million.
entries.e545cae7f61c45bb: Based on construction contracts with customers, this business designs and builds custom-built detached houses. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥124,494 million.
entries.f0890508f9c8985f: This is a detached house sales business that sells land and buildings as a set. With emphasis on capital efficiency and turnover, it mainly develops projects of 10 lots or fewer. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 is ¥47,669 million.
